title: Exercise acceptance completion after resolving an unchanged restart observation’s test obligation
outcome: Cover the full completion sequence with normal obligation rules active: after an exact same-source restart report, a current passing test satisfies the new obligation and completion uses the original unbound evaluation.
acceptance: With the stock rule set active, a named-root exact assumed_missing_baseline report opens a test obligation after a passing evaluation. A subsequent passing host check on the declared SourceId satisfies the obligation. Completion seals the original evaluation ID.
